washstand.description: Stardew Valley interior furniture, one object alone on a transparent background, drawn square-on from the front with its top seen as a flat band above the front face, no side faces visible at all, one tile is 16 pixels, warm wood colours, dark coloured (not black) outlines: an old inn's wooden washstand, two tiles wide, a white porcelain wash basin and a tall jug standing on top, a folded towel hanging over the front rail, one small cupboard door below

armchair.description: Stardew Valley interior furniture, one object alone on a transparent background, drawn square-on from the front, no side faces visible at all, one tile is 16 pixels, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a cosy upholstered armchair in faded burgundy facing straight out at the viewer with a knitted blanket over one arm, and beside it on the right a small round wooden side table with a teacup on it

coatstand.description: Stardew Valley interior furniture, one object alone on a transparent background, seen straight from the front, one tile wide and two tall, one tile is 16 pixels, warm wood colours, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a wooden coat stand with curved hooks, a brown wool coat and a straw hat hanging on it

sampler.description: Stardew Valley wall decoration, one object hung flat on a wall, square-on, alone on a transparent background, one tile is 16 pixels, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a framed cross-stitch sampler in a simple wood frame, cream linen with a little stitched house, two hearts and a border of red and green stitches
